abstract.t: This document specifies how to represent DNSSEC public and private keys as JSON Web Keys (JWK). The cryptographic key material is encoded using the existing JWK key types, and the DNS-specific information needed to reconstruct the corresponding DNSKEY resource record (owner name, algorithm, protocol and flags) is carried in a new JWK parameter, "dnskey". This gives DNSSEC signers, key management systems and other tools a standardized, interoperable format for exchanging and storing DNSSEC keys.
